goal:
Add a user-placeable comet body type to the Universe Sandbox game in Sandbox/UniverseSandbox.

A comet is a low-mass icy body on a steep elliptical orbit that grows a visible tail pointing directly away from the nearest star, longer the closer it gets. This must work end to end:

- physics.py: a 'comet' body type that participates in gravity, merging and black-hole absorption like any other body.
- sprites.py: an icy, irregular comet surface distinct from the existing types.
- render/: draw the tail, scaled by distance to the nearest star and pointing away from it.
- ui.py: a 'Comet' button in the toolbar next to the existing body buttons.
- main.py: wire the button to an add_comet() action that places one at the current focus.
- _smoke_test.py: add checks that a comet is created, that its tail direction points away from the star, and that the tail is longer when the comet is nearer the star.

Verify by running: python _smoke_test.py in Sandbox/UniverseSandbox. Every existing check must still pass unchanged - do not weaken or remove any of them - and your new comet checks must pass too. Update _plan.md with what you did.
